entities.name: Ignatius Gregory Peter VI Shahbaddin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mar Ignatius Gregory Peter VI Shahbaddin (1641–1702) was the Patriarch of the Syriac Catholic Church from 1678 to 1702. His death under circumstances marked the end of the first attempt of union between the Syriac Orthodox Church and the Catholic Church.
